g.text: ◆ CONVERSATION WITH MIU — llama3 | Esc: encerrar Ctrl+S: salvar
Hi! Nice to meet you! How are you today?
Good! I'm good too, thank you. Do you like your city?
Yes, I do. I live in São Paulo, and I like that there are many things to do here.
That's great! São Paulo is a big city, yes? What kind of things do you like to do there?
ype in English and press Enter...
